verdict.rationale: GitCafe shows no native pipeline-as-code feature. Its only CI evidence is a Buildkite integration: builds appear on the repository's CI tab and as pull-request checks, and per-pipeline results can be published to GitHub. Pipelines are therefore defined in an external tool, and nothing in the evidence describes a YAML syntax or in-repo pipeline file. Missing for 10: native CI/CD runner, documented YAML pipeline syntax stored in the repository, pipeline configuration docs, independent corroboration.
